notes: Variant unit WLC.JDG.11.37.v001 is underdetermined and resolves to r00-base over s031-s033; both readings are compatible with the ASV, so this is not rule 53's excluded-fallback case and nothing was marked added or unrepresented on its account.
The phrase's one determiner is the demonstrative's, so both articles of `הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה` are unrepresented (rules 41 and 47).
